# Design guidelines: @leafygreen-ui/modal

Design snapshot: mongodb.design, fetched 2026-10-01.
Page: https://www.mongodb.design/component/modal/design-docs

## Overview

Modals can be used to display a simple task, to confirm actions, prompt users to input information, or display additional information.

## How to use this component

Use a concise title to inform the user of what action they are about to take.
